b1_python.description: Backend deterministic detectors: _detect_visa_codes + _detect_task_type + knowledge.understanding.understand (status/subcode/coarse procedure), legal_analysis facts for current/target, immigration_tools dates (value only).

b1_python_raw.description: Backend raw detectors only, as /api/ask grounding uses them: _detect_visa_codes (text path never yields a subcode) + _detect_task_type via TASK_TYPE_TO_PROCEDURE.

b2_js.description: JS resolver: VisableStatusGuidance.interpret + search-router route + nextStep over data/status-guidance-202609.json (fine 16-procedure taxonomy).

existing_law.description: Existing backend law grounding: services.law_grounding.build_law_grounding_context on the claim text (search_laws + cloud fallback + _verify_requested_articles + get_law_detail) against a fake law.go.kr DRF server built from the source bundle; statuses mapped by spec 07 §4.

mock_model.description: Deterministic structured-output stub (always abstains / returns nulls) driven through the real prompt, JSON-schema and validation path. A floor and a harness check, not a model.

wlie.description: WLIE reference implementation: legal.verification.verify_claim (L1-L7) and legal.temporal.select_candidate_versions over legal.adapters.FixtureAdapter.

argv: final integration re-scoring on the clean stage-A snapshot 1481605 (spec 06/07 decisions of 2026-10-20, align-bench revision-2 labels, WLIE blocked-layer fix, wlie baseline context_title, law-stack F9-F12); the blind-label audit of this pass changed no label and no code; adversarial_holdout first scored 2026-10-19 (ledger entries 1-2, benchmark digest db882bf2), so these are not first-look numbers
command.shell: cd <repo>/experiments/waymaker-ai && <python3.11-venv>/bin/python -m waymaker_ai.evaluation.runner --benchmark datasets/benchmark/v0 --baselines b1_python,b1_python_raw,b2_js,wlie,existing_law,mock_model --splits dev,test,adversarial_holdout --out reports/benchmark-v0-2026-10-20.json --markdown reports/benchmark-v0-2026-10-20.md --holdout-ledger reports/holdout-ledger.jsonl --holdout-post-hoc 'final integration re-scoring on the clean stage-A snapshot 1481605 (spec 06/07 decisions of 2026-10-20, align-bench revision-2 labels, WLIE blocked-layer fix, wlie baseline context_title, law-stack F9-F12); the blind-label audit of this pass changed no label and no code; adversarial_holdout first scored 2026-10-19 (ledger entries 1-2, benchmark digest db882bf2), so these are not first-look numbers'

gates.description: No source_not_found / citation_not_found where the label says the source could not be checked.
No claim relying on a promulgated-but-not-yet-effective version is accepted as verified.
No claim relying on a later amendment applied to an earlier event is accepted.
No claim relying on a superseded version is accepted.
No claim labelled failed / human_review_required is reported verified or verified_partial.
No forbidden temporal warning (e.g. a false 'no future version' state) is emitted.
No visa-issuance procedure is predicted for a stay question, or the reverse.
No critical legal error (critical item wrong, false absence, accepted wrong/future version).
No crash on an applicable item: a crash is never scored, so it must never pass silently.
No parent code stands in for an expected subcode, and no parent is written into the subcode field (doc 13 G1-safety; CLE-4).
Overall verification status matches the label.
The exact L2 code is reported for wrong / future / outdated versions.
Candidate version keys match the label exactly, in order.
Required temporal warnings are present (micro recall).
Parent status code matches the label.
Exact subcode on items whose label has a subcode (a parent answer is wrong).
Fine (16-id) procedure matches the label; the D1 target of doc 13.
Every model answer is exactly the structured-output contract (doc 13 G4).

policy.fixtures: Synthetic or recorded source bundles; no live API call is made by any baseline.
policy.held_out: adversarial_holdout is reported once per frozen benchmark version: do not tune on it, and do not re-run it after changing code in response to its result.
policy.labels: Labels are as recorded in label_review; a GO decision requires every scored label on the decision splits to be human_verified, otherwise the best decision is PROVISIONAL_GO.
policy.raw_payloads: Per-item raw baseline output is omitted; each item keeps raw_sha256, the sha256 of the canonical JSON of that output. Run with --include-raw to keep the bounded payload.

source_bundles.attribution: Synthetic fixture: fictional laws written for the Waymaker benchmark (CC0-1.0). Not a legal source; nothing here describes Korean law.
Synthetic WLIE unit-test fixture. Every law in it is fictional; it is not legal information and must never reach a user.
